people.line: A clan or family known for their warriors.

people.name: Sibbecai
people.line: One of David's mighty men, a Hushathite.

people.name: Zerah
people.line: Son of Judah, twin of Perez

translations.web: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
